memory_update.text: Add MU as direct US-listed HBM exposure within the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced packaging node.
Add AMKR as a US-listed OSAT/advanced packaging and test capacity candidate tied to TSMC Arizona and AI/HPC packaging demand, but require proof of leading-edge AI accelerator package revenue.
Add TER as an HBM and advanced 3D package test equipment candidate; monitor whether HBM4 and chiplet complexity increase test intensity.
Add FORM as a less obvious probe-card and wafer-test interface supplier for HBM, known-good-die, and advanced packaging workflows.
Add ONTO as an inspection/metrology/process-control supplier for AI advanced packaging, HBM interconnects, and 2.5D/3D integration yield.

This pass did not fully map US-listed substrate, interposer, thermal-interface-material, specialty chemical, and electronic design automation/IP suppliers; those require a separate focused Layer 1B expansion.

node: AI accelerators, HBM, and advanced packaging
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced-packaging chokepoint beyond the obvious GPU designers. The most relevant additions are Micron for HBM supply, Amkor for outsourced advanced packaging and test capacity, Teradyne for HBM and 3DFabric test, FormFactor for probe cards and known-good-die test in HBM/advanced packaging, and Onto Innovation for inspection/metrology/lithography process control in AI advanced packaging. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
